messages:
maia (People Ops): Quick update for this cycle: piloting "manager pair-review" to speed up calibrations + a short emergency-extension checklist. Please read and react.

maia (People Ops): Manager pair-review = two managers co-sign the manager_summary for cross-functional ICs (e.g., infra + product). Goal: reduce back-and-forth during calibration for matrix roles.

oliver (People Ops): How to opt in: add `pair: <peer-manager-email>` in the manager_summary header. Both managers must submit before the form deadline; the system will mark the case as paired.

rana (Eng Manager): For paired reviews, which manager gets notified for calibration slot? We have different timezones.

maia (People Ops): The pairing flow uses the primary manager's slot by default. Add `preferred_slot: AM/PM` in the sheet if you need timezone-aware matching.

ke (IC): Emergency extension question: my manager is traveling and missed the deadline. What's the walk-through?

oliver (People Ops): Emergency extension checklist (short): 1) manager posts reason in this thread; 2) attach a quick summary PDF named `ext-<last>-<first>.pdf`; 3) we auto-grant a 48h unlock for verified reasons (medical, travel out of zone). Use the extension form: https://forms.redwood/extension

maia (People Ops): Note: extensions are logged. Repeated last-minute unlocks will trigger a follow-up with the manager to improve cadence (we'll warn first).

sam (Recruiting): For paired hires, can recruiting attach interview packet for context?

maia (People Ops): Yes — attach `hirepkt-<last>-<first>.pdf` or paste a 1-line hiring context in manager_summary. Paired cases usually benefit from extra context.

forms-bot: Reminder: review forms due in ~24 hours. Link: https://app.redwood/reviews

rana (Eng Manager): We'll try manager-pair-review for two matrix ICs this cycle.

ke (IC): Appreciate the extension checklist and pairing idea.

maia (People Ops): Thanks all — we'll publish a 1-pager with the pair-review example snippets and the short extension form link in #review-ops in 30m. Ping @oliver or me for unlocks.
